note: Twenty measured regions, twenty accounted: thirteen figure rows for ten printed figure numbers (Figure 3 split into its two framed panels and Figure 8 into its three) and seven counted tables for nine printed table numbers. Table 1 on p5 and Table 8 on p19 print but return no measured region, so both are declared gaps and no bbox is invented for them. Table 5 is split over the p15/p16 turn and only its second half is measured.
rules: Figure 3 and Figure 8 print one number each over panels that are framed separately, so each framed panel gets its own row and repeats the printed number [caption.numbering].
Figures 4 and 5 print as one raster holding two unframed panels, so each is a single row with panel_count 2 rather than two rows [geometry.panel_count].

Table 5 runs over a page turn - caption and first half at the foot of p15, continuation at the head of p16 - and only the p16 half is measured, so that row carries `continued` and the note says where the rest prints [table.continued].
Table 9's header prints seven labels over six columns of values, counted as printed rather than corrected [table.cols].

Figure 9's y-axis prints '/通用格式' placeholder text on every tick because the pasted chart's typeface is missing, so `printed_numbers` is false even though ticks are drawn and the values are given in Table 8 [geometry.printed_numbers].
Figure 9 repeats Table 8's caption - 'indexes of topic 7, 11, 13' - word for word, quoted as printed [caption.verbatim].
Table 2 and Table 3 are introduced by a bare colon sentence ('The conspirators identified by Fisher Discriminant are:') and no numbered citation, so their mention blocks are empty [mention.count].
Two printed tables return no measured region at all: Table 1 finishes p5 and Table 8 sits under Figure 8 on p19, so both are declared gaps rather than invented bboxes [caption.verbatim].
Figures 6, 7 and 10 state their encoding in the caption only - no scale, key or axis label is printed inside the panel [geometry.legend].
